feature: Render-confirmed removal of a redundant explicit birth-year category

nativeBirthFieldContract.rule: Only the registered native principal person infobox and its accepted reviewed birth fields. Existing family or parameter migration is not used as proof.

eligibility: Full wikitext article in namespace 0 with a positive page ID and base revision ID, no section editing, redirect, disambiguation or discussion context.
Exactly one complete principal person infobox. A literal subject name must match the article title, and every populated field must be accepted by that native profile.
Exactly one accepted birth field contains one direct Dni call or a verified redirect, optionally followed by unchanged trailing references.
Literal unambiguous four-digit year from 1000 through the current UTC year, with optional valid numeric month and day. Explicit positional parameters are resolved without guessing.

Only parameters 1, 2, 3, 4, lang, nowrap, nocat, circa and c are recognized. Duplicate or unsupported parameters, nonempty nocat, nonempty circa or c, dynamic values and invalid or future dates decline.
The fourth parameter may be empty, si or sem idade. These values do not suppress the birth-year category. lang, when nonempty, must be br or pt.
The matching explicit category must be on its own line after the infobox, without a pipe or sort key, template/ref/table nesting, or inline content. Identical plain duplicates may all be removed.
Any other explicit Nascidos em year category, any matching piped category, or an active includeonly, noinclude or onlyinclude control anywhere in the article declines this feature.
A current anonymous parse of the exact complete infobox must return the exact same birth-year category with an empty explicit sort key, matching page title and no API or parse warnings.
preservation: Only approved explicit birth-category lines are deleted. The infobox, Dni, source dates, trailing citations, other categories and their sort keys are preserved.
DEFAULTSORT is permitted and left unchanged. The preservation endpoints compare its ordered key inventory and all remaining category keys.

Production composition and preservation audits accept only the unchanged original category inventory or the exact recomputed deletion projection. Existing proven namespace normalization, obsolete short-description category cleanup and identical duplicate consolidation remain possible.

Proof binds the exact full source, source hash, infobox, page title, namespace, page ID, revision ID and full-page context. It expires after five minutes and is recomputed before accepting a deletion.

runtime.cache: Bound to the exact page context and full source; no cross-page or changed-source authorization.

unsupportedExamples: Dni hidden in a conditional or unused template argument
sourceAttribution: Primary template revisions are linked by permanent revision URL. No editorial account metadata is retained.
